tokens.name: espresso
tokens.usage: Primary ink and the dark ground. Body text on white, cream and gray (14:1+). Full-bleed dark sections: cover, section rails, offer pitch, closing.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Secondary ink. Eyebrows, card labels and summaries on white, cream or gray (7:1+). Full-width urgent / time-sensitive band with cream text (7.8:1). Never text on espresso (1.8:1).

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Signature accent. Eyebrows on espresso (4.5:1). Fix boxes and rX header as a fill with espresso text (4.5:1). Card top borders, offer numerals 24px+. Not for small text on white or cream (3.4:1).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: In the palette but not used on the audit page. Reserve for small signal moments. Text only 24px+ on white (3.8:1) or espresso (4.1:1).

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Script and emphasis on espresso: Quick Signature lines, the xoxo sign-off, <em> inside display headlines, footer links (5.2:1). Never text on white or cream.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Text on espresso (14.2:1) and moss (7.8:1). Light ground for the brand-identity panel.

tokens.name: gray
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and card outlines on white. Gap colour for metric grids.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Default page background. Never pure #fff.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy in cards and lists on white (6.0:1) and cream (5.6:1).

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy on espresso (5.8:1). Do not go below 0.55 alpha for text.

tokens.name: on-dark-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and footer rules on espresso. Decorative only.

tokens.name: olive-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted callout ground on espresso, with a 3px olive left rule. Cream text.

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: Section titles and closing lines. Uppercase. clamp(34px, 5vw, 56px).

styles.name: display-h3
styles.usage: Card values, offer names, priority titles. Uppercase.

styles.name: ghost-num
styles.usage: Oversized section numeral at 5–6% opacity behind a title.

styles.name: script-hero
styles.usage: Signature moments only: the Kyra Aulani name, xoxo sign-off, one short closing line. Rose on espresso.

styles.name: script-cta
styles.usage: Single closing phrase inside a dark panel. Rose.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Name the outcome. Show the proof.

styles.name: body-xs
styles.sample: One clear first step instead of five.

styles.name: lead-bold
styles.usage: The one recommended line inside a fix box.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above every heading. Olive on espresso, moss on light grounds.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to heading.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card grid gap, list item spacing.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and callout padding; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Column gap; space between priority items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Maximum page gutter; section padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Maximum vertical section padding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: cards, boxes, buttons, images. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Status icon discs (✓ / !) only.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Card outlines and row dividers on white.

tokens.name: border-accent
tokens.usage: Card top accent; section bottom rule.

tokens.name: border-cover
tokens.usage: Bottom edge of the cover.
